fichas.title: Electromagnetic Fields
fichas.summary: Overview of electrical, magnetic and electromagnetic fields in the human environment, their potential biological effects, regulatory threshold values, and recommended precautions. The page describes low-frequency exposure from power systems and appliances, high-frequency exposure from mobile telephones, body currents induced by fields, and magnetic flux-density measurements for household appliances at several distances.
uses: Describe electrical, magnetic and electromagnetic fields
Explain potential biological effects of field exposure
Provide regulatory threshold values and precautionary recommendations
Compare household-appliance magnetic flux densities at different distances
